result.reason: The redline reaches at least the fallback position: Customer retains a roughly 30-day notice right, early-termination charges are capped at three months’ recurring Charges, and prepaid Charges attributable to the post-termination period must be refunded. The clause does not grant IBM a convenience-termination right. The changes are limited to the required cap and refund and preserve the original termination structure. Drafting is professional, though stating that the refund is pro rata and clarifying the calculation basis for variable recurring Charges would be slightly more precise.
